item.title: Join Evermind’s Memory Genesis Competition!
item.description: One of the biggest limitations of today’s AI systems isn’t intelligence — it’s memory. Despite rapid advances in large language models, most AI agents still “forget” prior interactions once a session ends, forcing developers to rely on short-term context windows or token-heavy workarounds that don’t truly scale.
